SELECT MIN(densvalue), MAX(densvalue), COUNT(*) FROM physical_properties WHERE densvalue IS NOT NULL;

-- Check what mass values look like (in Jupiter masses)

-- Check star mass values in solar masses
SELECT MIN((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float), MAX((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float), COUNT(*) FROM stars WHERE stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value' IS NOT NULL AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float > 0;

-- Let's check what a rocky super-Earth looks like
-- Rocky: densvalue > 3
-- Super-Earth: mass between 1 and 10 Earth masses = massjup * 317.83 between 1 and 10
SELECT 
    pp.objectlink,
    pp.massjup,
    pp.radjup,
    pp.densvalue,
    pp.massjup * 317.83 as mass_earth,
    pp.radjup * 11.209 as rad_earth,
    (pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2) as surface_gravity
FROM physical_properties pp
WHERE pp.densvalue > 3
    AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
LIMIT 10;

-- Find the rocky super-Earth with the strongest surface gravity, then calculate mass ratio to star
WITH rocky_super_earths AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.objectlink,
        pp.massjup,
        pp.radjup,
        pp.densvalue,
        (pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2) as surface_gravity
    FROM physical_properties pp
    WHERE pp.densvalue > 3
        AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
),
top_planet AS (
    SELECT objectlink, massjup, surface_gravity
    FROM rocky_super_earths
    ORDER BY surface_gravity DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    tp.objectlink as planetref,
    tp.surface_gravity,
    tp.massjup * 317.83 as planet_mass_earth,
    s.stellarref,
    (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float as star_mass_solar,
    (tp.massjup * 317.83) / ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float * 333030) as mass_ratio
FROM top_planet tp
JOIN planets p ON p.planetref = tp.objectlink
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink;

    (pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2) as surface_gravity
FROM physical_properties pp
WHERE pp.densvalue > 3
ORDER BY surface_gravity DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Final verification - show all details of the top rocky super-Earth
SELECT 
    pp.objectlink,
    pp.massjup,
    pp.radjup,
    pp.densvalue,
    pp.massjup * 317.83 as mass_earth,
    pp.radjup * 11.209 as rad_earth,
    (pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2) as surface_gravity,
    s.stellarref,
    (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float as star_mass_solar
FROM physical_properties pp
JOIN planets p ON p.planetref = pp.objectlink
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE pp.densvalue > 3
    AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
ORDER BY surface_gravity DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH rocky_super_earths AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.objectlink,
        pp.massjup,
        pp.radjup,
        (pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2) as surface_gravity
    FROM physical_properties pp
    WHERE pp.densvalue > 3
        AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
),
top_planet AS (
    SELECT objectlink, massjup, surface_gravity
    FROM rocky_super_earths
    ORDER BY surface_gravity DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST((tp.massjup * 317.83) / ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::float * 333030) AS numeric), 8) as mass_ratio
FROM top_planet tp
JOIN planets p ON p.planetref = tp.objectlink
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink;
